var p = msg.payload;
msg.topic = `INSERT INTO latest_telemetry (device_id, timestamp, gps_valid, latitude, longitude, lora_rssi, ble_rssi, motion_detected, battery_v) \
VALUES ('${p.device_id}', datetime(${p.timestamp}, 'unixepoch'), ${p.gps_valid ? 1 : 0}, ${p.latitude}, ${p.longitude}, ${p.lora_rssi}, ${p.ble_rssi}, ${p.motion_detected ? 1 : 0}, ${p.battery_v}) \
ON CONFLICT(device_id) DO UPDATE SET \
timestamp=excluded.timestamp, \
gps_valid=excluded.gps_valid, \
latitude=excluded.latitude, \
longitude=excluded.longitude, \
lora_rssi=excluded.lora_rssi, \
ble_rssi=excluded.ble_rssi, \
motion_detected=excluded.motion_detected, \
battery_v=excluded.battery_v;`;
return msg;
